title: Golden Leaf evolutions
notes: Golden Leaf: 15 new costumed evolutions arrive on Friday. From then on, a Pokémon in a Golden Leaf costume keeps it when it evolves, and each evolution has its own Full Art card.
changes: Day Care: when both parents wear any costume (even one from an old event, like Halloween), every baby now hatches in costume, even if the two costumes are from different lines. It wears the costume of the parent it takes after, if that costume can be passed on right now. One costumed parent: half the babies, as before.
Day Care: from Friday, a Pokémon in an evolved Golden Leaf costume passes the costume on too. Its babies hatch in their own form's costume.
fixes: Spectral Gilded Pokémon now keep their ghostly Spectral colours with a gold trim (Shiny ones: a platinum trim).
Safari: the odds tooltip now includes Scout's Focus. A Legendary you found with Scout's Focus shows its own chance with the focus in.
Floating Pokémon like Pumpkaboo and Magnemite now float on the map instead of walking.

title: Smoother updates
changes: Updates install more gently: your PC stays smooth while the game updates.
Weekly events are now translated: the Calendar, the event tips and the event days read in your language.

title: Weekly events, card odds and fixes
notes: Weekly events: from Monday 23 November every day has its own event, 12:00–24:00 UTC: Hatch Day, Radar Day, Raid Day, Trade Day, Safari Day and Shiny Day, plus Card Rush on Sunday. See them all on the Calendar.

Your odds: a Pokémon that came with its Full Art card now counts the card in its "1 in N" odds, Golden Leaf and encore Pokémon now show their odds too, and a Pokémon whose only rare part is its card shows the card’s chance.
Desktop app: new Safe mode in the tray menu (or press Ctrl+Shift+F10). It restarts the game on one monitor with graphics acceleration off, if the game ever covers your screens.
changes: Desktop app: the first time the game spreads over all your monitors, it asks if you can still see your desktop. No answer in 10 seconds and it goes back to one monitor with graphics acceleration off.
fixes: Tower Hard Mode: when catching can’t work on a floor, the battle now tells you so (you can battle on) instead of asking you to try again and again.
Gyms: a Gym that couldn’t start no longer quietly goes back to Challenge. Its card now says why, and a brief connection hiccup tries once more by itself.
